narrative.overview: Minimal, bespoke, intuitive native macOS photo workbench. Photographs dominate the intended browsing surface; native controls and precise hierarchy explain operations. M1 is a truthful local catalog shell awaiting indexing. Repaired full-size and compact native captures passed M1 visual review; dark readability was checked. Manual resizing, full Tab traversal, increased contrast and reduced motion retain verification follow-ups.

rules.name: The Photograph Rule
rules.body: Keep decorative color out of the image canvas; actual photographs carry the palette.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Color supplements meaningful state and is never its sole explanation.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Core actions have readable labels; icons support meaning.

rules.name: The Stable Place Rule
rules.body: Keep primary controls consistent and preserve meaningful selection through organization changes where possible.

dos: Do give photographs the greatest visual area and keep surroundings neutral.
Do use native macOS controls, focus behavior, SF typography and system appearance.
Do make constraints and important states readable.
Do distinguish selection, keyboard focus, availability and provenance.
Do preserve context through regrouping, source changes and indexing where possible.
donts: Don't replace labeled core actions with custom gestures or icon-only controls.
Don't add decorative gradients, glow, color washes or glass over imagery.
Don't surround every photo or metadata field with a card.
Don't hide uncertainty, offline availability or incomplete coverage.
Don't invent exact dynamic color, radius or SF metrics or claim visual sign-off from incomplete captures.
